output.summary: Large perennial herb native to Mexico, Central America, the West Indies and much of northern South America. Its fleshy rhizomes are edible and processed into an easily digested starch used in foods; archaeological evidence from Colombia shows arrowroot food use by 8200 BC.
output.edibilityNote: The edible rhizomes yield food starch; evidence of arrowroot food use in Colombia dates to 8200 BC.
